summary: Starts workspace dashboard queries early and displays each dashboard section as its data becomes available.
userImpact: The built-in organization dashboard can open while installed frontend plugins initialize.
Dashboard values have independent loading states so completed sections can be used while other sections are still loading.
security: Early dashboard reads require a verified organization session and the existing dashboard permission.
documentation: The dashboard uses the existing tenant-scoped API and preserves authorization for installed plugin routes.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible application images.
validation: Browser checks exercise dashboard data arriving independently of plugin loading and other dashboard requests.

customerDocumentation.reason: The existing dashboard controls and workflow are unchanged.
